_label: Lord-I-Call sticheron at verse (3), Prophet Obadiah (11-19)
_note: Same hymn, two translations. The base is our St. Sergius text in the Thee/Thou register; the parish sings the OCA wording in You/Your, printed in its packet. Verse (2) is not merely a register difference — the base reads “Of the primary traits * and essential proofs * wherewith God is made known” where the packet reads “The glorious and honorable prophets participate through communion by grace in the very attributes and properties by which God is made known”, which scored 0.42 against ours and counted as a MISS. The sheet marks these “To the special melody: All-praised martyrs”.

value.text:
As a shining vessel of the Spirit,
thou wast illumined by Him, Obadiah!
With most divine vision, thou wast enriched by the image of prophecy:
Foreknowledge of things to come and knowledge of the truth.//
Pray that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

variants.label: OCA wording, as the parish sings it
